stops.name: Parco regionale del Conero
stops.detail: The Conero Regional Park is a protected natural area of the Marches established in 1987 that extends over the homonymous promontory, in the province of Ancona. The Mediterranean vegetation gives the mountain the characteristic dark and brilliant green color. One of the most common trees is the corbezzole; the name Conero derives from the ancient Greek name of the corbezzole: 'κόμαρος (kómaros).
